skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills to include in the export. Each skill must have a name and files (including SKILL.md).

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Conversation ID to export. If provided, uses messages from this conversation instead of the agent's global message history.

scrub_messages.title: Scrub Messages
scrub_messages.description: If True, excludes all messages from the export. Useful for sharing agent configs without conversation history.
